paper_title: Improved constraints on non-Newtonian forces at 10 microns
coupling_convention: alpha (Yukawa strength relative to Newtonian gravity), from Table V; masses converted from Yukawa range lambda via m[eV] = 1.240e-6/lambda[m]
notes: Stanford cryogenic micro-cantilever test of Yukawa-type deviations from Newtonian gravity at 5-66 micron ranges ('Stanford 3' result). Table V lists 95% CL exclusion values of |alpha| at six explicit lambda values (4, 6, 10, 18, 34, 66 microns). Best bound in 5-15 micron range: |alpha| > 14,000 excluded at lambda = 10 microns. Coupling emitted is the raw Yukawa strength alpha relative to gravity (fifth-force / ISL test convention), not a dimensionless particle coupling g; downstream conversion needed if canonical g_N is required.
